name: 苏晚
source: 《八零新婚夜，空间囤货养崽暴富》女主

identity.en: A slender twenty-two-year-old Chinese peasant woman, early 1980s rural northern China
identity.text: 22 岁北方农村新媳妇，1980 年代初

face.en: Thin oval face with slightly sallow skin from malnutrition, but large bright determined dark eyes, straight thin eyebrows, pale lips, faint tiredness yet resolute gaze
face.text: 瘦长脸，脸色偏黄营养不良，但一双眼睛亮而有神，眼神冷静坚定

hair.en: Black hair pulled back into a single simple thick braid over one shoulder, centre-parted, no ornaments
hair.text: 黑发中分，简单扎成一根粗麻花辫垂在胸前，无任何头饰

top.en: A faded indigo-blue homespun cotton padded jacket, front-buttoned with traditional cloth knot buttons, patched at elbow and shoulder with contrasting scrap cloth, collar slightly frayed
top.text: 洗得发白的靛蓝色粗布对襟棉袄，盘扣，肘肩处打了几块不同色的补丁，领口磨旧

bottom.en: Dark grey coarse cotton padded trousers, cuffs tied, worn black cloth shoes with thick soles
bottom.text: 深灰色粗布棉裤，裤脚扎起，穿旧的黑布千层底棉鞋

details.en: The thick black braid hanging over her shoulder, its end tied with a frayed piece of red cotton string
details.text: 垂在胸前的粗黑麻花辫，辫梢系一截磨毛的红头绳

details.en: The frayed indigo collar and the hand-stitched cloth knot buttons of the padded jacket
details.text: 磨旧的靛蓝立领与手工盘扣

details.en: The elbow patch of contrasting faded brown cloth sewn onto the indigo cotton sleeve
details.text: 靛蓝袖子肘部一块打补丁的褪色棕布

details.en: Thick-soled worn black cloth shoes with patched toe caps, over grey cotton ankle wraps
details.text: 旧黑布鞋千层底，鞋头有补丁，配灰棉袜/绑腿

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
